note: PROTOTYPE configuration. Weights, normalisation limits and thresholds were chosen for demonstration and decision-support only. They are NOT official Government of India, NDMA or GSI thresholds and carry no warning authority.

rainfall.note: Rainfall in mm (24h equivalent, plus a damped share of longer accumulation) is scaled linearly to 0-1 up to the saturation value.

slope.note: Mean terrain gradient in degrees measured over a ~1 km DEM baseline (not a point maximum), scaled linearly to 0-1 between the flat and saturation values.

historical.note: Combines the number of recorded landslides within radiusKm (source-derived) with proximity to the nearest record.

terrain.note: Prototype proxy: local elevation relief (metres) sampled around the point from a public DEM. Official GSI susceptibility classes are NOT integrated in this phase.
